commands.name: planner-falls-back-to-fable-at-either-floor
commands.run: python3 -c "import importlib.util,sys; spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ar','claude/hooks/agent_runtime.py'); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m); caps={'models':{'opus':{'status':'unavailable','efforts':['high','xhigh']},'fable':{'status':'available','efforts':['medium','high']}}}; n=m.resolve_route('claude','planner',capabilities=caps); assert (n['model'],n['effort'],n['ready'])==('fable','medium',True), n; h=m.resolve_route('claude','planner',capabilities=caps,config={'difficulty':{'level':'hard','proposed':'hard','confirmed':True}}); assert (h['model'],h['effort'],h['ready'])==('fable','high',True), h; r=m.resolve_route('claude','plan_reviewer',capabilities={'models':{'fable':{'status':'unavailable','efforts':['high']},'opus':{'status':'available','efforts':['high','xhigh']}}}); assert (r['model'],r['effort'],r['ready'])==('opus','high',True), r; assert 'plan_reviewer' not in m.CRITICAL_ROLES and 'plan_reviewer' not in m.DIFFICULTY_ROLES"

commands.name: agent-runtime-suite-count-and-green
commands.run: f="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar-suite.$$"; env -u HERDR_ENV -u HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID -u HERDR_PANE_ID -u HERDR_TAB_ID -u WORKFLOW_PERSONAL_ACCOUNT bash claude/hooks/agent-runtime.test.sh > "$f" 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -1 "$f" | grep -qE '^(5[4-9]|[6-9][0-9]) passed, 0 failed$'; grc=$?; rm -f "$f"; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$grc" -eq 0 ]
